item.title: BeOne Medicines (Venclexta Challenger) FDA Approval
item.description:
• Summary: BeOne Medicines' Beqalzi (sonrotoclax) received FDA approval as a first-in-class BCL-2 inhibitor for mantle cell lymphoma, challenging Venclexta (venetoclax). The approval was followed by an FDA warning about misleading TV advertisements for the drug.
  • MoAs: Sonrotoclax (Beqalzi): BCL-2 inhibitor; Venetoclax (Venclexta): BCL-2 inhibitor.
  • Sources: Fierce Pharma, Fierce Pharma

item.title: Abeona Therapeutics Pivot to T-Cells
item.description:
• Summary: Abeona Therapeutics is pivoting its focus to T-cell therapies, signaling a strategic shift from its previous gene therapy programs. The move positions the company to pursue oncology applications.
  • MoAs: Adoptive cell therapy (T-cell)
  • Sources: Endpoints News

item.title: C4 Therapeutics EGFR Degrader Discontinuation
item.description:
• Summary: C4 Therapeutics has discontinued development of its EGFR degrader, a targeted protein degradation asset aimed at treating EGFR-mutant cancers, following a strategic pipeline review.
  • MoAs: Targeted protein degradation (EGFR degrader)
  • Sources: ApexOnco
